recipe.scaling: per-tensor current amax; power-of-two dequantization scale = 2**ceil(log2(amax / format_max)); zero tensors use scale 1
recipe.rounding: nearest, ties to even; clamp finite input to representable range before rounding
recipe.nonfinite: fail immediately; never silently replace NaN or infinity
recipe.linear_backward: dx = Q5(dy) @ Q4(w); dw = Q5(dy).T @ Q4(x); bias gradient if present uses unquantized dy
recipe.compute: dequantized FP32 GEMMs on MPS; not native FP8 arithmetic or TE-equivalent execution
recipe.modules: all five linear projections in every decoder block; embedding, head, attention matmuls, norms, residuals and loss remain FP32
recipe.persistent_state: FP32 parameters, accumulated gradients and AdamW states; current scaling is stateless

operator_acceptance.quantizer_matches_cpu_float8_cast: exact finite values for representable values, adjacent midpoints and nextafter neighbors, extremes and seeded random inputs; signed zero checked separately

training_acceptance.repeat_and_resume: exact tensors, optimizer state, RNG, input windows and numerical history

scope: Predeclared engineering checks for this tiny local simulation, not statistical convergence equivalence or H20/TE acceptance. FP8 training quantization error is distinct from implementation error at identical quantized operands. Do not tune bounds after measurement.
review_policy: Passing experiments are recorded as passed_pending_batch_review and work continues; preserve failures and investigate. User acceptance is deferred.
purpose: Post-run diagnostic of the observed context-4096 seed-17 step-22 trajectory gradient peak. Preserve training settings, add one same-weight/same-optimizer probe, and require exact reproduction of original numerical history and final states. No acceptance threshold change.
